title: Crop Production Practice  Arable And Horticultural Crops
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a place where plants are propagated and grown to usable size."
A nursery is a place where plants are propagated and grown to usable size.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to any technique that involves the use of natural enemies of weed plants to control the germination of weed seeds or the spread of established plants."
Biological Biological weed control refers to any technique that involves the use of natural enemies of weed plants to control the germination of weed seeds or the spread of established plants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term used in agricultural sciences to mean the removal of some plants, or parts of plants, to make room for the growth of others."
Thinning is a term used in agricultural sciences to mean the removal of some plants, or parts of plants, to make room for the growth of others..
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the traditional method, but hand-cranked or pedal-driven fans can be constructed easily."
Winnowing Methods Reliance on wind is the traditional method, but hand-cranked or pedal-driven fans can be constructed easily.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the 'measure of the closeness of an estimate (disease assessment) to the true value', and precision is defined as a 'measure of reliability and/or repeatability of disease assessments' (10)."

Accuracy is defined as the 'measure of the closeness of an estimate (disease assessment) to the true value', and precision is defined as a 'measure of reliability and/or repeatability of disease assessments' (10).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the fact that the base is on wheels and can be moved by the irrigator or affixed to a guide wire."
The name refers to the fact that the base is on wheels and can be moved by the irrigator or affixed to a guide wire.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to any technique that involves maintaining field conditions such that weeds are less likely to become established and/or increase in number."
Cultural Cultural weed control refers to any technique that involves maintaining field conditions such that weeds are less likely to become established and/or increase in number.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of covering the topsoil with plant material such as leaves, grass, twigs, crop residues, straw etc."
Mulching is the process of covering the topsoil with plant material such as leaves, grass, twigs, crop residues, straw etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to any technique that involves the use of farm equipment to control weeds."
Mechanical Mechanical weed control refers to any technique that involves the use of farm equipment to control weeds.
fib: ______ are used under conditions where soil is likely to adhere to the discs (Kamel, 1975).

Problems arise where disc openers are used under conditions where soil is likely to adhere to the discs (Kamel, 1975).
______ is the indication of ripened crops like rice and wheat.
Golden yellow color
The Golden yellow color is the indication of ripened crops like rice and wheat.
______ are used in modern farming and pick up the plants right from the windrows.
Tractor-drawn or self-propelLed threshers
Tractor-drawn or self-propelLed threshers are used in modern farming and pick up the plants right from the windrows.
______ refers to any technique that involves the application of a chemical (herbicide) to weeds or soil to control the germination or growth of the weed species.
Chemical weed control
Chemical Chemical weed control refers to any technique that involves the application of a chemical (herbicide) to weeds or soil to control the germination or growth of the weed species.
______ is used in pathosystems in which a single lesion per plant is critical, as well as for many wilt and systemic virus diseases (4).
Incidence
Incidence is used in pathosystems in which a single lesion per plant is critical, as well as for many wilt and systemic virus diseases (4).
______ is a horticultural and silvicultural practice involving the selective removal of certain parts of a plant, such as branches, buds, or roots.
Pruning
Pruning is a horticultural and silvicultural practice involving the selective removal of certain parts of a plant, such as branches, buds, or roots.
______ is an effective way to control annual weeds between corn rows.
Cultivation of row crops
Cultivation of row crops is an effective way to control annual weeds between corn rows.
______ is the most common method of seed treatment.
Seed dressing
Seed dressing is the most common method of seed treatment.
